hero.name: Boba Fett
hero.specialAbility:
THE BOUNTY HUNTER
After playing a BOUNTY card, tuck the card under the hero card of any opponent.
When Boba deals damage to an opponent's hero, choose and resolve 1 BOUNTY effect underneath that opponent's hero card.

ruleCards.content:
BOUNTY EFFECTS
BOUNTY effects only resolve when Boba Fett deals damage to an opponent's hero. When this happens, resolve a BOUNTY effect of your choice. Resolving BOUNTY effects due to damage may only happen once per combat.

TRANSFERING BOUNTIES
When a hero with a BOUNTY deals damage to another opponent's hero, they transfer 1 BOUNTY to that opponent. That hero cannot be on the same team as Boba Fett. When an opposing hero is defeated, discard all BOUNTIES underneath their hero card.
ruleCards.title: Bounties
